name: What are sones, and why do they matter when selecting a bathroom fan?

mainEntity.name: What are sones, and why do they matter when selecting a bathroom fan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fan loudness is measured in sones, where lower numbers indicate quieter operation. A fan rated at 4.0 sones sounds like a loud television or humming refrigerator, whereas a unit rated at 1.0 sone or below is virtually whisper-quiet. When planning an upgrade, especially in primary suites or guest baths near bedrooms, selecting a fan under 1.5 sones allows comfortable, prolonged use without disruptive noise. Quieter fans encourage homeowners to leave the unit running long enough to clear moisture completely from tile and cabinetry.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sones measure fan sound levels; lower ratings under 1.5 sones operate quietly, encouraging consistent use to fully exhaust moisture without disruptive motor noise.
